in_hebrew.name: Hebel
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hebel הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Hebrew havel, meaning breath or transience. In the Bible, Hebel is the name of the third son of Adam and Eve, and the name of the first man to die.

in_greek.name: Hebel
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Breath, transience
in_greek.long_meaning: Hebel είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew havel, meaning breath or transience. In the Bible, Hebel is the name of the third son of Adam and Eve, and the name of the first man to die.

in_latin.name: Hebel
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Breath, transience
in_latin.long_meaning: Hebel est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew havel, meaning breath or transience. In the Bible, Hebel is the name of the third son of Adam and Eve, and the name of the first man to die.
